preserved_analysis.summary: AI Incident Database incident 1660 reports that scammers used purportedly AI-generated videos impersonating Miami immigration attorney Angel Leal to solicit a Bronx legal resident seeking U.S. citizenship, resulting in a reported $4,820 payment and disclosure of Social Security and residency documents. The incident is preserved as an identity, representation and deception signal. The available registry evidence identifies the affected technology only at the class level—synthetic video generation, synthetic media generation, deepfake technology and social-media distribution—and does not identify a specific model or provider.
